name_input: M/S. SUPREME SALES AGENCY; SUPREME SALES AGENCY
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/supreme-sales-agency) — counter states "Total Shipments 8667 Records detected", "Trading Partners 24", "Ports 32", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-19"; rows actually visible on the free view: 4 shipment lines + 5 supplier rows + 5 buyer rows + 5 port rows (≈19 rows), i.e. the 8667 figure is a platform counter, not a count of records I could read. Exact record line: "2026-02-19 | SUPREME SALES AGENCY | K.A.T. AGRO NEPAL PVT LTD | CONNECTING ROD 170F GX220- RAXAUL | INRXLB, India | Birgunj, NEPAL | 84099990 | 9811195". Same B/L 9811195 also covers "MUFFLER ASSY 170F GX220" (HS 84099990), "CRANK SHAFT 170F GX220" (HS 84139190) and "SPEED CONTROL ASSY GX160" (HS 84139190). So: dated export shipment 2026-02-19, destination Nepal (Birgunj), port lane Raxaul (INRXLB), HS 84099990 / 84139190, B/L no. 9811195. Additional corroborating lanes visible on the same page: top ports "Novorossiysk 356", "MUNDRA SEA INMUN1 269", "PALWAL ICD INPWL6 253", "Odessa 186"; buyer rows include "ALWAYS BRIGHT LIMITED" (Tema, Ghana) and "TO THE ORDER, RUSSIA". Import side also present: suppliers "CHANGZHOU DIESEL IMP & EXP CO., LTD" (735 shipments), "SYBARITE-TRADE LLC." (68), "CHANGZHOU DIESEL IMPORT&EXPORT CO. LIMITED" (99) — i.e. the firm is an importer of Chinese small-engine spares and re-exports to Nepal/Africa/CIS.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by a dated customs record with B/L number, destination and HS code — not a website claim. Declared HS set (840999;842123;842199;870880) is only partly matched: observed records show 84099990 (matches 840999) and 84139190 (pump parts, not in the declared list); no records seen for 842123, 842199 or 870880 in the visible rows, so those codes are unverified rather than wrong. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be checked: the web_search tool returned connection errors on every attempt and volza/eximpedia free views returned HTTP 403, so GST/tender data is not public to me here — recorded as null/unknown, not as 'none found'. Address on record: 16A, Deshapran Sushmal Road, Flat-4D (Kolkata-area address string), which is consistent with the Raxaul/Nepal overland lane. Role reads as trader/re-exporter rather than manufacturer (no plant evidence seen; goods are branded GX160/GX220 Honda-clone engines sourced from Changzhou Diesel). No rejection grounds: entity clearly exists and is actively shipping in 2026.
